card.name: Spaces before numbers in dosing text
card.fires_on: Mostly the space just before a number (dose, range, day, section reference) in prescribing-information text, and sometimes a brand name such as TRODELVY or PADCEV being split up or followed by linking words like with or to.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space token right before a digit in a dose, range, day list or section reference.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Partway through a newer drug brand name such as TRODELVY.

modes.label: Linking word after a drug
modes.description: A small word like with or to following a drug name or combination.

card.plain: It fires on the gap before a number in dosing text, and on parts of newer cancer-drug brand names.
